name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a gold exploration company operating primarily in Nevada and Idaho, with a royalty and streaming structure that keeps overhead low. The company's flagship asset is the Lapon Canyon Gold Project in Nevada, where an active reverse circulation drill program targets intrusive-related gold deposits and feeder structures. The company also holds the Swales Property within the Carlin Trend, one of the world's richest gold-producing districts.
